title: Phoenix TSMC Fab 3 Topping-Out Record
summary: Phoenix records installation of the final and highest structural beam on TSMC Fab 3 and relays that initial construction had begun on a fourth fab and the first advanced-packaging plant.
key_findings: The Fab 3 event is a specific physical superstructure milestone.
The page identifies the planned process as 2 nanometer.
Later-facility starts are reported separately from completion or operation.
why_it_matters: The record advances the local semiconductor dossier beyond investment announcements into observable construction while preserving the later equipment, service, occupancy, qualification, and production stages.
ftfn_relevance: Adds a project-level construction event to the Southwest chip corridor.
Increases the relevance of the open power, water, wastewater, labor, and supplier gaps.
evidence_limits: Topping out does not prove building completion, occupancy, tool installation, qualification, or production.
Statements about later facilities, employment, and future output remain City-relayed company or partner claims.
